lines.text: The readers are dull of hearing and need milk, while solid food is for the mature.
The writer urges leaving the elementary teachings and going on to maturity, if God permits.
Those who fall away after being enlightened cannot be restored, because they crucify the Son of David again.
Land that drinks rain and bears a useful crop is blessed, but thorny land will be sold.
God will not forget the readers' work, and they should imitate those who inherit the promises through faith and patience.
